stem: Which quotation best supports the thesis of the article?

options.label: F
options.text: "When you open your eyes, imagine you’re seeing the world for the very first time," Choukas-Bradley told us. (paragraph 10)

options.label: G
options.text: "It’s my hope that the health care system will include [forest therapy] into the range of services they reimburse for," Clifford says. (paragraph 14)

options.label: H
options.text: "Medical researchers in Japan have studied forest bathing and have demonstrated several benefits to our health," says Philip Barr. . . . (paragraph 17)

options.label: J
options.text: "I’m very impressed with the primary research done in Japan," Barr says. (paragraph 21)
